capabilities: Import paper metadata from arXiv by ID or URL via command palette
Download the paper's PDF into the vault alongside the metadata
Render imported papers from a custom external template file
Configure the folders where notes and PDFs are saved
extras: README warns the template file is not valid Obsidian markdown and should be edited in source mode.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch a paper's metadata and PDF from arXiv by ID or URL into a note.
summary: Imports arXiv paper metadata and optionally the PDF into vault notes, using a customizable note template.
